meta.side: contingent liabilities (off-budget) — NOT part of the budget total
meta.headline: Gujarat's outstanding guarantees: ₹3,656 cr — 2.85% of revenue receipts; ₹16,344 cr headroom under the ₹20,000 cr ceiling. Outside the on-budget total — the part of the books the budget does not show.
meta.off_budget_note: Outstanding guarantees ₹3,656 cr = 2.85% of revenue receipts. Sardar Sarovar Narmada Nigam Ltd still the largest exposure (35%).
meta.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year ended 31 Mar 2021, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 1 of 2022)
meta.caveat: Contingent liabilities, not budget spending — a charge on the Consolidated Fund only if a guarantee is invoked. NOT part of the on-budget total. Source: CAG SFAR (ex Finance Accounts Statement 20). RBI 'State Finances' guarantees statement = pending cross-check.
